title: farcross
description: Farcross is an ongoing Minecraft java and bedrock network that introduces a seasonal SMP and events!
body:
# FARCROSS NETWORK

Are you a Minecraft player looking to join a new SMP?

**Well join Farcross!**

This is a fun medieval-themed Minecraft Server Network for both Minecraft Java and Bedrock
You should join because there is no other server like it and there's a great community!

There's so much to do, including:
> Custom Weapons and tools

> Friendly Staff and Community

> Land Claims

> Clans, Nations, and wars

> Bedrock Support

> Unique Enchants

> Epic Quests

> Voting rewards

> New updates often!

**Ready to join? Here's how!**
> IP: farcross.xyz

> Bedrock Port: 19132

> Version: 1.16-Latest


**Make sure to follow our socials!**
> [Discord](https://discord.gg/ymummGpAhN)

> [Youtube](https://www.youtube.com/@farcrossnetwork?sub_confirmation=1)

> [Webstore](https://farcross.tebex.io)
